Method.Implementation: $$$TRACE("GetTpLink: S= " _ interchangeSenderID _", R= " _ interchangeReceiverID _", T= " _ transType _", D= " _ direc) &SQL(select r.ID, r.name, r.Ack, r.Folder, tp.Folder, tp.CommunicationProtocol, r.Separators, tp.InterchangeIdQualifier into :lId, :lNm, :ack, :lFld, :tpFld, :protocol, :separators, :interchangeIdQualifier from IHC_ERP_TPManage.TRADELINK r, IHC_ERP_TPManage.TPID t1, IHC_ERP_TPManage.TPID t2, IHC_ERP_TPManage.TRANSACTIONTYPE tr, IHC_ERP_TPManage.TradingPartner tp where r.IsaSenderId = t1.ID and t1.TPID = :interchangeSenderID and r.IsaReceiverId = t2.ID and t2.TPID = :interchangeReceiverID and r.TRANSACTIONTYPE = tr.ID and tr.Name = :transType and r.Direction = :direc AND tp.ID = t1.TPFK) // $$$TRACE(transType _", " _ lId _", " _ lNm _"," _ ack _", " _ lFld _", " _ tpFld _", " _ protocol) set retVal = lId _"," _ lNm _"," _ ack _"," _ lFld _"," _ tpFld _"," _ protocol _"," _ separators _"," _ interchangeIdQualifier return $$$OK
